description: Every fixture file under datasets/ with its SHA-256, size, producer, provenance category and generator command. Provenance categories: 'native' = written by an independent Parquet writer (pyarrow) including the profile metadata; 'native-with-profile-metadata' = independent-writer output to which profile metadata was added afterwards (unused so far: pyarrow writes stamps, sorting_columns and the page index itself); 'mutated' = deliberately edited by generators/mutate_metadata.py (data pages preserved unless a change says otherwise); 'generated' = a text file (manifest) written by a generator.
reproducibility: Byte-reproducible with the pinned pyarrow: two regenerations produce identical files (pyarrow 26.0.1 footers carry no timestamps). If a future writer is not byte-reproducible, the checked-in bytes stay authoritative and STRUCTURE.txt must remain identical.

datasets.name: empty
datasets.description: A committed dataset with no parts.

datasets.name: basic
datasets.description: One part, two row groups of six rows, key pages of two rows; uncompressed PLAIN v1 pages.

datasets.name: multipart
datasets.description: Three parts listed out of file-name order, several row groups and pages each, leading/interior/trailing empty row groups, SNAPPY/ZSTD/GZIP, dictionary and DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY keys, data page v1 and v2, sha256 in the manifest, an extension, and a stray Parquet file under the root that is not part of the dataset.

datasets.name: binary-keys
datasets.description: Keys exercising unsigned byte order: NUL, 0x7F/0x80, 0xFF, invalid UTF-8, UTF-8 whose UTF-16 order differs, prefix chains, keys longer than 64 bytes (pyarrow does not shorten bounds), and long keys of 0xFF bytes. Pages of 3 rows.

datasets.name: projection
datasets.description: Projected values of every mandatory physical type with nulls, special floats given by exact bits (signed zero, infinities, NaN payloads), unsigned-annotated INT32/INT64 reported as signed physical values, and a top-level column literally named a.b; the key column carries the STRING annotation; part 1 lacks columns f64 and req, only part 2 has column extra; meta (struct) and tags (list) are nested.

datasets.name: delimiter
datasets.description: Folder-like keys: keys equal to prefixes, trailing and repeated delimiters, a delimiter at the start, non-ASCII bytes used as delimiters, keys beginning with 0xFF, and the common prefix a/b/ spanning a part boundary. Pages of 2 rows.

datasets.name: list-bounds

datasets.name: non-utf8-keys
